messages:
jamal: Quick heads-up: Kicking off deploy to prod in 10m. Pinning model-service to v3.8.2 for this change. Canary 5% -> 20% over 30m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-evac-ladder

deploy-bot: deploy started — canary=5% target=20% window=30m. CI: green. Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345 :rocket:

andrea: noted. release-notes updated: https://wiki.redwood/releases/2026-03-20-model-service. Included rollback steps and perf baseline.

sre-elaine: Confirming rollback criteria: error-rate >0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increase >200ms vs baseline for 3m. Also watch token-rate dropouts.

jamal: yes that's the plan. Also evac ladder in runbook — steps in order: 1) pause rollout, 2) revert traffic routing to previous pool, 3) unpin to v3.8.1, 4) escalate to oncall+platform.

oliver: Adding a quick config snippet for the canary anchor if anyone needs it:
```
canary:
  start: 5
  step: 5
  max: 20
  step_interval: 600s
pin: v3.8.2
fallback_pin: v3.8.1
```

sre-elaine: deploy-bot — if error-rate metric crosses threshold trigger `evac-ladder` tag and post to #incidents.

deploy-bot: noted. Will post status updates and `evac-ladder` if triggered. current canary=5%.

jamal: if we need to execute evac-ladder, follow checklist in runbook and call `incident-bot` to open P0 channel. I'll be on standby.

incident-bot: P0 channel created: #p0-v3-8-2-deploy (link: https://slack.redwood/p0/xyz) — responders: @sre-elaine @oliver @jamal

andrea: small note — metrics dashboard is here: https://dash.redwood/model-service/perf. Keep an eye on redis errors and KV cache miss rate.

oliver: rolling forward to 10% now.

deploy-bot: canary increased to 10% — monitoring.

sre-elaine: seeing slight p95 uptick on one region (us-west). If it reaches +250ms I'll stop rollout.

jamal: agreed. stand by for abort if needed. :thumbsup:
